purpose: Document the literal placeholder strings accepted by scripts/comfyui_api.py.

placeholders.__LINEART_IMAGE__: Use as the image filename in a LoadImage node for the CAD lineart.
placeholders.__DEPTH_IMAGE__: Use as the image filename in a LoadImage node for the CAD depth map.
placeholders.__COLOR_PREVIEW_IMAGE__: Use as the image filename in a LoadImage node for the shaded CAD preview.
placeholders.__PROMPT__: Use as the positive prompt text.
placeholders.__OUTPUT_PREFIX__: Use as the SaveImage filename prefix.

note: Export the real ComfyUI graph in API format, place these literal strings in the appropriate node inputs, and set comfyui.workflow to that JSON file.
